provenance.method: lesson notes written from the NERDC 2025 scheme of work outline; every week keeps its scheme topic and bullets as the teaching spine

topics.title: Sight words 2
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify sight words. The pupils should be able to read sight words correctly.
Introduction:
We learned some sight words last week. Today we will learn more sight words.
Content:
Sight words are words we see often. The words are he, she, we, me, my, you. Let us say them together. He is a boy. She is a girl. We are friends. That is me. My book is red. You are my friend.
Class activity:
Flash card game. Show pupils the words one by one. Pupils read the words aloud.
Evaluation questions:
Can you read the word he? Can you read the word she? Which word means me?
Summary:
Today we learned more sight words.

topics.title: Consonant blends 1
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify consonant blends. The pupils should be able to read words with bl, cl, fl.
Introduction:
We learned letters and sounds. Today we will learn letter blends.
Content:
Consonant blends are two consonants together. The blends are bl, cl, fl. Blue has bl. Clap has cl. Flag has fl. Let us say the sounds. Bl, cl, fl. Now let us read the words. Blue, clap, flag.
Class activity:
Point to objects with bl, cl, fl sounds. Pupils name the objects and say the sounds.
Evaluation questions:
What sound does blue start with? Can you clap? What has the fl sound?
Summary:
We learned consonant blends bl, cl, fl.

topics.title: Consonant blends 2
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify sl, sm, sn blends. The pupils should be able to read words with these blends.
Introduction:
We learned bl, cl, fl blends. Today we learn sl, sm, sn.
Content:
Sl, sm, sn are consonant blends. Slide has sl. Small has sm. Snap has sn. Let us say the sounds. Sl, sm, sn. Now let us read the words. Slide, small, snap.
Class activity:
Word sort. Pupils sort picture cards into sl, sm, sn groups.
Evaluation questions:
What word has the sl sound? Is small big or small? Can you snap?
Summary:
We learned sl, sm, sn blends.

topics.title: Consonant digraphs 1
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify sh digraph. The pupils should be able to read sh words.
Introduction:
Today we learn a special sound. Two letters make one sound.
Content:
Sh is a consonant digraph. It makes one sound. Ship has sh. Shop has sh. Fish has sh. Let us say the sh sound. Now let us read the words. Ship, shop, fish.
Class activity:
Fish for sh words. Pupils catch paper fish with sh words.
Evaluation questions:
What sound does ship start with? Can you go to the shop? What animal is fish?
Summary:
We learned the sh digraph.

topics.title: Consonant digraphs 2
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify ch digraph. The pupils should be able to read ch words.
Introduction:
We learned sh digraph. Today we learn ch digraph.
Content:
Ch is a consonant digraph. It makes one sound. Chat has ch. Chin has ch. Chip has ch. Let us say the ch sound. Now let us read the words. Chat, chin, chip.
Class activity:
Chip the ch words. Pupils tap cards when they hear ch words.
Evaluation questions:
What sound does chat start with? Where is your chin? What is a chip?
Summary:
We learned the ch digraph.

topics.title: Digraph th
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify th digraph. The pupils should be able to read th words.
Introduction:
Today we learn the th digraph. It makes a special sound.
Content:
Th is a digraph. It makes one sound. This has th. That has th. Thin has th. Thick has th. Let us say the th sound. Now let us read the words. This, that, thin, thick.
Class activity:
Read and sort. Pupils sort th words into two groups.
Evaluation questions:
What sound does this start with? Is that big or small? Is thin thick?
Summary:
We learned the th digraph.

topics.title: Magic e with a
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to identify magic e. The pupils should be able to read a e words.
Introduction:
Today we learn magic e. It changes vowel sounds.
Content:
Magic e makes vowels say their name. A with magic e says a. Cake has magic e. Gate has magic e. Lake has magic e. Let us read the words. Cake, gate, lake.
Class activity:
Magic e wand. Pupils wave wands at words to make magic e work.
Evaluation questions:
What sound does a make with magic e? Can you eat cake? Where is a gate?
Summary:
We learned magic e with a.

topics.title: Magic e with i and o
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to read i and o with magic e. The pupils should be able to change words with magic e.
Introduction:
We learned magic e with a. Today we learn with i and o.
Content:
Magic e makes i say i. Kite has magic e. Bike has magic e. Magic e makes o say o. Home has magic e. Stone has magic e. Let us read the words. Kite, bike, home, stone.
Class activity:
Change pin to pine. Pupils add magic e to change words.
Evaluation questions:
What does pin become with magic e? Can you ride a bike? Where is home?
Summary:
We learned magic e with i and o.

topics.title: Reading sentences
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to read sentences. The pupils should be able to read with expression.
Introduction:
We learned many words. Today we read sentences.
Content:
Sentences are words together. We read sentences from left to right. The kite is on the bike. Let us read the sentence. We stop at the period.
Class activity:
Read with expression. Pupils read with happy voice.
Evaluation questions:
What is on the bike? Can you read the sentence? Where is the kite?
Summary:
We learned to read sentences.

topics.title: Revision and blend contest
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to review digraphs and blends. The pupils should be able to participate in a reading contest.
Introduction:
We learned many sounds this term. Today we play a game.
Content:
We review digraphs sh, ch, th. We review blends bl, cl, fl, sl, sm, sn. We review magic e words. Let us say all the sounds together.
Class activity:
Digraph and blend games. Pupils race to read words correctly.
Evaluation questions:
What sound does ship make? What has the blend fl? What does cake have?
Summary:
We had a fun reading contest.
